label: Tube size
description: Outside diameter x wall, in mm; used for a wind chime

name: bar_size
label: Flat bar size
description: Width x thickness, in mm; used for a glockenspiel (a bar bends through its thickness)

name: tuning_offset
label: Test piece reads (cents)
description: Leave at 0, cut one tube or bar to the output Test piece, not drilled, hang it in a loop of string at 22.4 % of its length, tap it and read a tuner against note 1 (minus is flat; if the tuner names the note above note 1, add 100 to its reading, the note below, subtract 100). Enter it: every length corrects itself. Flat: trim the piece to note 1's new length. Sharp: it is now too short for note 1, so trim it to note 2's new length and cut note 1 again

name: hang_style
label: How the tubes hang
description: Wind chime only. Bottoms level rings best (the striker reaches each tube's end); tops level looks calm; middles level balances the two

name: wind_speed
label: Wind that makes it ring (m/s)
description: Wind chime only. A gentle breeze is about 2 to 3 m/s; the sail is sized so the striker just reaches a tube at this wind, within limits of size (see the output for the wind it really rings at)

name: gust
label: Gust (slider)
description: Wind chime only. Drag it: the striker and sail swing with the wind, at 100 % the striker just touches a tube

title: Tuned chimes
description: A wind chime of metal tubes, or a glockenspiel of flat bars, tuned by the free-free beam formula: pick the notes and the stock you bought, and every piece gets its length and its node holes. A form output gives every cut length and hole position; the cut-and-drill sheet (full-size strips, one per note, with the disc and the sail) exports from File, Export, Sheet of set: Cut sheet, as SVG or DXF. Every length is calculated; real metal differs, so the form takes your tuner reading of a test piece and corrects the rest.
